title: Modular Multi-Agent Hierarchy and Tool Orchestration SDK
oneLiner: Google's open-source Agent Development Kit (ADK) enables developers to compose hierarchical agents (`SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `LoopAgent`) with built-in dev UI and Vertex AI deployment.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Google's open-source Agent Development Kit (ADK) enables developers to compose hierarchical agents (`SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `LoopAgent`) with built-in dev UI and Vertex AI deployment.

steps: Launch `adk web` to inspect event traces
Deploy to Cloud Run or Vertex AI Agent Engine.
configSnippet: "Coordinate a ParallelAgent to gather market news and SEC filings simultaneously, then pass results to a SynthesisAgent."
